craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta-adbhuta of closing praise — vismaya that proof flees the fated yet Self shines within all. Fitness-flees-fated: thousand-proved-yet-astraly; Jewel-slips-away close. Rejected: (a) astray→lost → killed: astray wanders. Read aloud: A-thou-SAND BLAZ-ing REA-sons-PROVE … JEW-el SLIPS a-WAY.

lines: A thousand blazing reasons prove — yet not for minds astray;
palm-held Maheśvara flees the fated: Jewel slips away.

reads_against.argmap: Proved — yet for whom in vain? → Proof needs fitness; the jewel flees the fated.
c1_essence: Proof needs fitness: thousand-proved, it fails the deluded; the palm-held Jewel flees the fate-struck (v55). Self flashes as Īśvara within all breathers, maker and knower; recognition to be effected, joining made elsewhere; the proof stands even in duality — midnight fire (v56).
